item.title: ciot: a cpu inference engine for ternary networks
item.description: 0.54 ms per 1024x1024 ternary matvec on a snapdragon x laptop. zero dependencies, one binary, ~3,000 lines of c++ and python.

item.title: Building a Membership System That Says "I Don't Know"
item.description: Most failure detectors lie. STYX is a distributed membership system that returns a probability distribution instead of a boolean, handling uncertainty with honesty.
